verdict.rationale: SerpApi is a search-data API/tool provider, not an AI agent or agentic platform that would itself consume/plug in external MCP servers. The evidence instead shows SerpApi ships its OWN MCP server so that agents can consume SerpApi as a tool (serpapi-docs-21, serpapi-probe-4) — the inverse relationship, which is the correct axis for this product type, not this story's client-side axis.
